Class ChaosHandleRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.spring.boot.common.ChaosHandleRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.beans.factory.DisposableBean
public final class ChaosHandleRegistry extends Object implements org.springframework.beans.factory.DisposableBean
Holds the handles of plans the starter activates for the application (the startup plan), so they stop when the application context closes.

Implements DisposableBean so handles registered against this bean are stopped when the enclosing Spring context closes. The underlying ChaosControlPlane is a JVM-wide singleton and is intentionally not closed here — only the handles owned by this context are released. A startup plan is held through activateShared(ChaosControlPlane, ChaosPlan): contexts with the same plan share one activation, which stops when the last of them closes.

  • Method Details

    • register

      public void register(ChaosActivationHandle handle)
      Records a newly-activated handle so it stops with the context. A handle registered under an id already held replaces the previous one, which is stopped; once the context is closing, the handle is stopped at once instead.
      Parameters:
      handle - the handle returned by activate(...); must not be null

    • activateShared

      public ChaosActivationHandle activateShared(ChaosControlPlane controlPlane, ChaosPlan plan)
      Activates plan on controlPlane, or joins the activation of the same plan (equal canonical JSON) that another context in the JVM holds. A Spring test suite caches several contexts with one startup plan file; the plan runs once and stops when the last context holding it closes.
      Parameters:
      controlPlane - the JVM-wide control plane
      plan - the plan
      Returns:
      the plan's handle, shared by every context holding the plan
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if this context is closing
      RuntimeException - what the activation throws; nothing is held then
